items.text: Side A's page is about five times taller than B's at the same 1440px width.
items.evidence: A page_height 29448 vs B 5774; both page_width 1440. A was cut into 23 slices, B into 5.

items.text: The two pages have different document titles. A's title is SEO-style with a 'Top US … Blogger' phrase; B's names the brand and author with an em dash.
items.evidence: A: 'Top US Interior Design and DIY Projects Blogger | Never Skip Brunch'. B: 'Never Skip Brunch — DIY & Home Design by Cara Newhart'.

items.text: The H1 text and styling differ. A's H1 is the centered brand name in caps; B's H1 is the welcome line, larger and start-aligned.
items.evidence: A h1 'NEVER SKIP BRUNCH', 50px playfair, centered. B h1 'welcome to never skip brunch.', 73.6px 'Playfair Display', text-align start, shown

features.statement: Page title names the brand and author with an em dash and a plain descriptive tagline rather than SEO keyword phrasing.
Hero H1 is a large, start-aligned friendly welcome sentence in a serif display face rather than a centered brand name.
Typography combines a clean sans body face with a serif display face and a handwritten script accent, using only three families.
Small pink handwritten script eyebrow labels sit above section headings.
A vivid magenta-pink accent color is used for text, bars, buttons and small marks against warm neutrals.
Announcement bar is a solid colored strip with small sentence-case white text and an underlined link.
Header places a small logo on the left and a single right-aligned row of navigation links.
Hero is a split layout with text on one side and an arch-topped portrait image on the other.
Hero image is cropped into an arch shape with rounded corners and a soft drop shadow.
Hero background is a soft peach-to-cream gradient.
Buttons are fully rounded pills in solid black, outlined, white or accent-colored variants.
Content sits within a consistent wide side gutter with sections aligned to the same left edge.
Content blocks use rounded cards with soft borders or pale tinted fills, including text-only post cards in a row.
Sections use 50/50 split layouts pairing an image with a colored panel with serif title and italic accent word.
Category tags and pagination appear as small rounded pills or circles, with the active page filled dark.
Call-to-action banners center white italic serif copy over a darkened photo with a white pill button.
Social or feed content is shown as a compact grid of caption cards with small accent icons.
Footer is a dark multi-column block with small white circular social buttons, compact newsletter signup and muted copyright below a divider.
Numbered link lists use sentence-case white labels with small accent-colored numerals.
Inputs are rounded white fields paired with a circular accent submit button.
Headings follow a clean hierarchy with a single H1, H2 section titles and H3 post titles.
Markup is lean, with few semantic landmarks, few classes and a modern grid and flex layout.
Interactive elements use many CSS transitions for hover polish.
Body text is about 17px with a moderate line height and a short compact page.
Copy is lowercase and conversational, with small decorative glyphs like ✦ and arrows as ornaments.
Images are few and meaningful, with concise descriptive alt text.
